description: How an app's pain points changed over time: compares two archived analyses and labels each theme new / resolved / rising / falling / stable with share deltas (percentage points). Instant (archive read, no LLM). Default: latest vs ~30 days earlier. Returns a note when the app has fewer than two snapshots yet.

appId.description: App Store / Google Play / Steam / WordPress.org / Chrome Web Store URL, iOS / Mac App Store numeric id (e.g. 324684580), Android package (e.g. com.spotify.music), Steam appid (e.g. 730), WordPress plugin slug (e.g. woocommerce) or Chrome extension id — get ids from search_apps

store.description: optional — inferred from appId (App Store URL or 5-12 digit id → ios, Play URL / package → android, Steam URL or 1-4 digit appid → steam); iOS and Mac App Store share the same URL shape, so pass "macos" explicitly for Mac apps. steam: details/search only for now — mining/reviews return steam_reviews_unavailable

name: get_pain_trend
title: Pain-point trend
